description: v5 (2026-09-21): the nightly conversation-list harness (harness/voice_conversation_list_nightly.mjs) gains a wall-clock `--deadline HH:MM` stop and an optional `--chain-reconcile` step that, after card generation ends, calls the pass-2 reconcile harness and the morning-question CLI's `present` command in this same process via dynamic `import('./estate_voice_card_reconcile.mjs')`/`import('./voice_question_cli.mjs')` — both files were already named entry points below (v4) and already covered by the `guild_hall/context_engine/` tracked_paths prefix, so this bump adds no new tracked_paths or entry_points, only two of the already-listed files (`voice_conversation_list_nightly.mjs`, `ops/register-voice-conversation-list-task.ps1`) changing in place; the hidden launcher (`ops/run-voice-conversation-list-hidden.vbs`) is untouched (it only relays argv, so nothing about a new flag needs it to change) and stays listed only because the registrar resolves it from this lane's own copy. The registrar gains `-DailyAt` (default 03:00, unchanged behaviour with no new parameter given), `-Deadline` and `-ChainReconcile` (+ pass-through: `-ReconcileReceiptsRoot`/`-LinearRoot`/`-MailRoot`/`-QuestionsCap`) parameters, each folded into its existing pin/plan-digest/XML-attestation checks. This bump registers no task and builds no lane by itself. v4 (2026-09-21): adds the pass-2 card reconciliation harness and the morning-question CLI (harness/estate_voice_card_reconcile.mjs, harness/voice_question_cli.mjs) as named entry points, for the first real (non-dry) reconcile + present run Owner approved on 2026-09-18. Both are invoked manually from this lane's own copy for now — there is no scheduled task for either in this version, the same as every other named entry point below. Their import closure (voice_attribution_policy.mjs, voice_morning_questions.mjs, voice_route_cli.mjs, voice_routes.mjs, voice_session_read.mjs, estate_inventory.mjs, and the rest) lives entirely under guild_hall/context_engine/, already tracked_paths wholesale, and every file the closure reaches outside that directory (engineering_engine/kernel+validators, gateway/mail_body_excerpt.mjs, knowledge_access/ledger.mjs, path_registry/src/*, rag/*, shared/*) was already in tracked_paths below (confirmed by walking the same relative-import closure guild_hall/deployment_pack/tools/spec_closure_lib.mjs's moduleClosure() computes for the repo's other spec emitters) — so tracked_paths itself needed no new entries this bump. v3 (2026-09-20): adds the voice conversation-list nightly harness and its scheduled-task registrar (harness/voice_conversation_list_nightly.mjs, ops/register-voice-conversation-list-task.ps1, ops/run-voice-conversation-list-hidden.vbs) as named entry points, so a built lane's Resolve-CanonicalFile can find them; this spec bump registers no task by itself. v2 (2026-09-15, main d1cbbf5d): the read lane now also carries the voice conversation-list pipeline (voice_conversation_list_cli.mjs, prompts/voice_conversation_list/) and the voice route CLI, and the read CLI answers --voice-session --conversation-list --corrections. The lane the context bot's skill calls to read: guild_hall/context_engine/harness/estate_graph_query.mjs finds an item and guild_hall/context_engine/harness/estate_original_read.mjs reads that item back to its original, including the attachment list and one attachment's text or page images. No scheduled task runs this lane — it is called per question, which is why it is separate from graph-sync-v1 (the 30-minute writer) rather than folded into it: a read lane can be rebuilt without touching the lane that is holding a lease. tracked_paths are the context engine plus exactly the dependency files its own runtime closure records, the same set graph-sync-v1 carries, so the two lanes stay byte-comparable where they overlap. There are no carried_forward_prefixes: every module imports node: builtins only.
